description: A positive Goodstein term gives a strict decrease of the next ordinal measure.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.goodstein_descent (m n : ℕ)
  (hp : 0 < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.goodstein m n) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.ordinalMeasure (n + 3)
      (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.goodstein m (n + 1)) <
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.ordinalMeasure (n + 2) (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.goodstein m n)
